Tisdale was born in Fort Worth, Texas.[2] His father, Louis Tisdale, was a well-known pastor in Tulsa, Oklahoma, serving for 21 years as senior pastor of Friendship Church.[4] After his father died in 1997, the former Osage Expressway in Tulsa was named L.L.
